Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching everything. I reviewed the files with Naomi (vendor ops) and Rishi in finance. A couple of follow-ups so we can clear procurement checks and release a PO: 

1) Signature authority: our legal team needs a short org-level proof showing Giovanni Rinaldi is authorized to sign on behalf of Ferrata (board resolution or company extract). The W-8BEN-E signature is helpful but we need the authorization doc to satisfy our policy.
2) Treaty claim support: on the W-8BEN-E Giovanni checked box 14 for treaty benefits. Can you confirm which treaty article and withholding rate Ferrata expects to claim for royalties/service fees (if applicable), and attach any local tax office confirmation if available?
3) Bank verification: the bank letter looks fine; finance may also request a voided ACH or an instant micro-deposit verification if possible.

If we get the authorization doc and a short note on treaty position by Thursday (06/24), we can aim to route PO approval for next week. For now procurement has left the PO in a "platform hold" pending these items.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Sourcing Manager, Redwood Inference
